conventions.pyramid: All five pyramid levels plus the JSON page index, as the atlas ships.

dominance: dominatedBy names one row in the same package convention that is no worse on bytes, mean error and maximum error, and better on at least one.
errors: Height errors are against the prepared 10 m reference on all 1,050,625 nodes.
streams: Stream overlap is the Jaccard index of D8 stream cells (contributing area at least 500 cells, 0.05 km2) on reference and reconstruction. A routing diagnostic, not a hydrological simulation.
